---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement, new capability, or change in behaviour
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The problem

What are you trying to do that nano makes hard, awkward, or impossible?
Describe the user-facing problem before the proposed fix — it gives us room
to consider solutions you may not have thought of.

## Proposed solution

Your concrete idea. Be specific. UI changes? New nPL command? New API? New
detection rule shape?

## Alternatives considered

What else did you try or think about? Why isn't it good enough?

## Edition relevance

- [ ] Open-core (everyone)
- [ ] Enterprise (Cases / pivt / risk / incidents)
- [ ] Both

If enterprise, the issue may be triaged into a private tracker — that's
expected; we'll comment with the routing.

## Anything else

- Concrete usage scenario (a real query, log type, detection idea, etc.)
- Links to similar features in other tools, with notes on what works / doesn't
- Are you willing to contribute the implementation? (We're happy to point you
  at the right files; the CLA flow is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md))
